reviewerIsolationMethod: Separate read-only reviewer with no participation in the repair; independently parsed live artifacts, ran the exact production validator with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, and compared complete Graphify and Codebase inventories before and after review.

lineageChecks.description: Production validator enforces the complete lineage status vocabulary and evidence semantics.

backupChecks.evidence: Independent extended-length-path traversal and per-file SHA-256 comparison.

validatorChecks.evidence: Direct invocation, AST inspection, and before/after tree aggregates.

validatorChecks.description: Validator is absolute for all lineage semantics and evidence payloads.
validatorChecks.evidence: Static control-flow inspection of LIN-05 through LIN-23.

receiptChecks.description: Review-package zero-blocker claim is supported by validator, challenge, and inventory evidence.

blockers.description: The challenge report declares PASS even though every challenge records META-10 as a pre-existing baseline failure; the harness subtracts that baseline failure and never requires a clean baseline.

The strict validator does not enumerate allowed resolution statuses or validate RECLASSIFIED and ALIAS semantics, and it does not bind MERGED or capability/task evidence payloads to authoritative source and target evidence.
The candidate authority inventory records 162 rows for FINAL_GATE_REPAIR_MANIFEST_CANDIDATE.jsonl while the live file contains 166.

majorFindings.description: Challenge baseline acceptance violates the required zero-current-defect adversarial-validation condition.
Lineage validator and challenge coverage are incomplete for the declared semantic vocabulary and evidence integrity.
Candidate inventory metadata is stale relative to its candidate manifest.
